lyrics: まいにち まいにち ぼくらはてっぱんの
うえで やかれて いやになっちゃうよ
あるあさ ぼくは みせのおじさんと
けんかして うみに にげこんだのさ
はじめて およいだ うみのそこ
とっても きもちが いいもんだ
おなかの あんこが おもいけど
うみは ひろいぜ こころがはずむ
ももいろ サンゴが てをふって
ぼくの およぎを ながめていたよ
まいにち まいにち たのしいことばかり
なんぱせんが ぼくのすみかさ
ときどき サメに いじめられるけど
そんなときゃ そうさ にげるのさ
いちにち およげば はらぺこさ
めだまも くるくる まわっちゃう
たまには エビでも くわなけりゃ
しおみず ばかりじゃ ふやけてしまう
いわばの かげから くいつけば
それは ちいさな つりばりだった
どんなに どんなに もがいても
ハリが のどから とれないよ
はまべで みしらぬ おじさんが
ぼくを つりあげ びっくりしてた
やっぱり ぼくは たいやきさ
すこし こげある たいやきさ
おじさん つばを のみこんで
ぼくを うまそうに たべたのさ

translations.romaji: mainichi mainichi bokura wa teppan no
translations.english: day after day, we are on the griddle

translations.romaji: ue de yakarete iya ni nacchau yo
translations.english: getting grilled until we've had enough

translations.romaji: aru asa boku wa mise no ojisan to
translations.english: one morning, I had a fight with the shopkeeper

translations.romaji: kenka shite umi ni nigekonda no sa
translations.english: and escaped into the sea

translations.romaji: hajimete oyoida umi no soko
translations.english: swimming for the first time on the ocean floor

translations.romaji: tottemo kimochi ga ii mon da
translations.english: it feels absolutely wonderful

translations.romaji: onaka no anko ga omoi kedo
translations.english: though the red bean paste in my belly is heavy

translations.romaji: umi wa hiroi ze kokoro ga hazumu
translations.english: the sea is vast, and my heart leaps

translations.romaji: momoiro sango ga te o futte
translations.english: pink corals waved their hands

translations.romaji: boku no oyogi o nagamete ita yo
translations.english: watching the way I swam

translations.romaji: mainichi mainichi tanoshii koto bakari
translations.english: day after day, it's nothing but fun

translations.romaji: nanpasen ga boku no sumika sa
translations.english: a fishing boat is my home

translations.romaji: tokidoki same ni ijimerareru kedo
translations.english: sometimes I get bullied by sharks

translations.romaji: sonna tokya sousa nigeru no sa
translations.english: but in times like those, that's right, I just run away

translations.romaji: ichinichi oyogeba harapeko sa
translations.english: after swimming all day, I'm starving

translations.romaji: medama mo kurukuru mawacchau
translations.english: even my eyes start spinning around

translations.romaji: tama ni wa ebi demo kuwanakerya
translations.english: if I don't eat a shrimp every now and then

translations.romaji: shiomizu bakari ja fuyakete shimau
translations.english: I'll just get soggy from all the saltwater

translations.romaji: iwaba no kage kara kuitsukeba
translations.english: when I snapped at something from the shadow of a reef

translations.romaji: sore wa chiisana tsuribari datta
translations.english: it turned out to be a tiny fishhook

translations.romaji: donna ni donna ni mogaitemo
translations.english: no matter how and how much I struggled

translations.romaji: hari ga nodo kara torenai yo
translations.english: the hook wouldn't come out of my throat

translations.romaji: hamabe de mishiranu ojisan ga
translations.english: on the beach, a strange man

translations.romaji: boku o tsuriage bikkuri shiteta
translations.english: pulled me up and looked surprised

translations.romaji: yappari boku wa taiyaki sa
translations.english: after all, I am a taiyaki

translations.romaji: sukoshi koge aru taiyaki sa
translations.english: a taiyaki with a few burnt spots

translations.romaji: ojisan tsuba o nomikonde
translations.english: the man swallowed hard

translations.romaji: boku o umasou ni tabeta no sa
translations.english: and ate me up with gusto
